correctness.rationale: fPO iff zero-cost allocation of every asymmetric chore, because each wrongful placement is independently Pareto-improvable and the fully corrected allocation has minimum total cost c. Fixed x yields exact WEF interval. With a>0, WEFX applied to agent 2’s zero-cost type-(1,0) chore gives x>=L in every support point; ex-ante WEF forces E[x]<=U, hence one supported x<=U. Otherwise b>0 gives symmetric argument. Deterministic WEF implies WEFX. Binomial count and both-asymmetric existence follow by direct integer argument. Checked all edge ranges a,b,c,d>=0, a+b>=1, 0<p<1, c=0 and empty bundles. Exact standalone full enumeration: 16,200 parameter cases and 2,211,840 complete allocations; additional 54,450 recurrence tests.

value.rationale: An exact if-and-only-if solution of a motivated strong best-of-both-worlds weighted binary-chore feasibility question, including a structural collapse from lotteries to one deterministic exactly fair outcome induced by just one asymmetric chore. Exact counting of all witnesses and guaranteed feasibility when both exclusive types occur. Resolves an actual gap between recent positive equal-weight and negative weighted general theorems, not an arbitrary restricted numeric slice; exact natural integer criterion supports constructive evaluation. Limitations: no all-shared case, no >2 agents or alternate EFX+.
